Service is operating between White City and Ealing Broadway / West Ruislip every 10 minutes, between Liverpool Street and Woodford via Hainault every 10 minutes, between Leytonstone and Epping every 30 minutes and between Woodford and Hainault via Chigwell every 20 minutes.
